reason: A settings-based plugin marketplace for browsing community plugins, viewing GitHub metadata, and managing plugin installation, updates, uninstallation, and reload behavior through the dsh CLI.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 设置中提供可搜索的社区插件目录，并支持通过 dsh CLI 安装、更新、卸载和管理插件。
summaries.en: Adds a searchable community plugin marketplace to DSH settings for installing, updating, uninstalling, and managing plugins through the dsh CLI.

capabilities: Displays a searchable and filterable catalog of community plugins
Fetches repository metadata from the GitHub API
Installs, updates, and uninstalls plugins through the dsh plugin CLI
Automatically updates installed plugins at startup when enabled
Hot-reloads compatible plugins and prompts for restart when native modules are present
Performs dependency and boot-composition checks with rollback after failed installation
